messages:
jules.r: Heads-up: QA found several invoices from the 2026-05-04 daily run missing GPU compute lines. Example inv_01122q (starlift). PDF was sent but totals look low.
mike.l: Which pipeline? nightly or ad-hoc?
jules.r: Daily `daily-2026-05-04-06z`. Logs show emit before backfill. Snippet: 
```
[06:03:10] emitInvoice(inv_01122q) status=EMITTED total=240.00 items=2
[06:03:11] backfillUsage(inv_01122q) status=COMPLETED added=3
```
Emitted early.
sara.b: Billing-bot flagged 9 invoices missing sku `compute.gpu` and 2 invoices with duplicate S3 keys for PDFs.
billing-bot: Alert: missing_expected_rows (9 ids), duplicate_s3_put (2 ids). Report -> s3://billing/alerts/2816000000/report.json
harper: For dupe PDFs, looks like pdf-worker retried after a transient 502 and re-uploaded without checking existing key. We'll add idempotency on the upload and check invoice STATE before sending.
mike.l: Agreed. For the missing rows we should avoid re-sending customer emails until we reconcile. Proposed plan: 1) Pause outgoing email for run daily-2026-05-04-06z. 2) Run `billingctl reconcile --batch daily-2026-05-04-06z --dry-run --out /tmp/recon-2816000000.csv`. 3) If deltas <= $5k auto-approve re-emit; else route to finance-approvals.
sara.b: Small correction: threshold is $7,500 per current policy.
mike.l: Thanks. I'll use $7,500.
support: We'll prepare customer-facing language for any reissues and a proactive note for the 2 accounts with duplicate PDFs.
jules.r: Kicked off dry-run at 2816000050. Early results: 9 invoices affected; deltas range -$40 to +$6,200. No one exceeds $7,500.
billing-bot: Dry-run output uploaded: s3://billing/recons/dry-2816000000.csv. Summary: 9 invoices gain compute lines, new totals increase accordingly.
mike.l: Ok to auto-approve re-emit for these 9. Steps: mark invoices DRAFT, apply backfill: `billingctl backfill --batch daily-2026-05-04-06z --apply --ids $(cat /tmp/ids-2816000000.txt)`, then `billingctl emit --batch ... --force --no-email` for QA pass, then send emails after sign-off.
harper: I'll patch pdf-worker to add an S3 put idempotency token and a check for invoice.state != "SENT" before upload. Small PR incoming.
support: Prep message templates ready in /docs/support/templates/reissue-daily-2026-05-04.md.
jules.r: I'll run the backfill and post logs here. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
